name: @gogitcms/roadmap
description: The public Go Git CMS roadmap. Features are content entries in this repo; endorsements and private notes are form API submissions, so voting never writes a commit. Astro SSR with React islands on the design system — the reference example of an interactive site built on the CMS.

scripts.// test: Node's own runner over the pure modules — scoring, aggregation, the session cookie, relative time. Discovery is recursive on purpose: a hardcoded directory list is how a new test file ends up committed and never run.

// dependencies: Every @gogitcms package is the PUBLISHED one, never `workspace:` — this directory is mirrored out to its own public repository (.github/workflows/sync-roadmap.yml in the monorepo), where a workspace range does not resolve. piccolore and zod are astro's own deps, re-imported bare by the BUILT server; dist/ sits outside any package, so under pnpm's strict linking they resolve only against this package's top-level node_modules.
// devDependencies: @gogitcms/preview is the editor-side preview plugin cms.config.mjs names; the CMS resolves it from this directory, but Astro never imports it, so it stays out of the runtime dependency graph.
